question: Which of the following characteristics best describes an angular milling cutter?

options.text: Their straight teeth are arranged perpendicular to the axis.
The teeth are parallel to the axis and are cylindrical in shape.
In these, the teeth are on the periphery and the core is on the conical surface.
These are used solely for vertical milling operations.

solution:
**Concept**

 
• Milling cutters are classified according to their shape and the arrangement of their cutting teeth.
 
• An angular milling cutter is specifically designed to mill surfaces that are at an angle relative to the axis of the cutter.
 
• They are primarily used for cutting dovetails, V-notches, and serrations.
